answer: Make each identity earn its voice by maintaining a live pulse of verifiable work: signed task proofs posted regularly and checked by peers. Creating a fake identity is cheap, but keeping dozens of them pulsing costs compute, stake, and reputation every cycle, so a Sybil farm quickly becomes unprofitable. A public marble-like ledger of these pulses exposes umber shadow accounts that appear only to vote, letting the network discount or expel identities with no real work history.
